description: AI-Powered security analysis of an AWS IAM policy (identity policy or cross-account trust+identity pair). Flags privilege-escalation paths, wildcards, and other over-permissive access. Runs in demo mode (rate-limited, no signup) if SHIELDLY_API_KEY is not set.

policy.description: The IAM policy JSON as a string. For cross_account, a JSON object with identityPolicy and trustPolicy.

policyType.description: identity (default) for a normal IAM/resource policy, or cross_account.

name: analyze_iam_policy
title: Analyze AWS IAM Policy
